sentences.text: A 16S sequencing study of 32 children with cow's milk allergy and 36 age-matched healthy controls reported Negativibacillus massiliensis enriched in the allergic children relative to healthy cow's milk consumers.

A study profiling faecal microbiota of 88 chronic kidney disease patients and 26 healthy controls reported a higher abundance of Negativibacillus massiliensis among haemodialysis patients compared with controls.

In a shotgun metagenomic study of 30 adults with B-cell lymphoma receiving CAR-T therapy, Negativibacillus massiliensis was one of six species used by machine-learning models to identify non-responders.
